title: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: For this part,you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on online dictionaries.You can start your essay with the sentence "Online dictionaries are becoming increasingly popular".You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Online dictionaries are becoming increasingly popular among students and office workers alike. With a smartphone in almost everyone's hand, looking up a new word no longer means flipping through a thick paper book. The main reason behind this trend is convenience. Whenever I meet an unfamiliar word while reading, I can simply type it in and get its meaning, pronunciation and example sentences within seconds. Moreover, many apps store my search history, so I can review difficult words on the bus or before an exam. However, this handiness also has a downside. Some students rely on it so heavily that they check every single word instead of guessing from the context, which actually slows down their reading ability. In my opinion, online dictionaries are a helpful tool as long as we use them wisely. We should enjoy the speed they offer while still training ourselves to think independently. In this way, technology serves our learning rather than replacing our own effort.
keyPoints: 照抄首句加对比。开头 "Online dictionaries are becoming increasingly popular" 逐字照 抄给定首句保住得分前提，紧跟 among students and office workers 把使用人群落地，再用 no longer means flipping through a thick paper book 做今昔对比，落实了'首句照抄再引现象'。
观点例证加让步。主题句 The main reason behind this trend is convenience 先亮分论 点，Whenever I meet an unfamiliar word 引出具体场景当例证，再用 However, this handiness also has a downside 转折补局限，正是'主体段先观点后例证'的落地。
表态加升华收束。In my opinion... as long as we use them wisely 亮态度并加条件，末句 technology serves our learning rather than replacing our own effort 用正反对照升华，兑现'结尾表 态给建议'。
